title: STEP 21 — Model adequacy & error source diagnosis
purpose: diagnose the error structure and adequacy of the surface passive-advection model without changing any STEP 17–20 result; no alpha search, no reselection, no tuning

step20FrozenReference.conclusion: Calibration-selected alpha=0.002 did not show a consistent performance advantage over alpha=0 on the 12 evaluable KE holdout drifters.

CALIBRATION.source: STEP 20 calibration trajectories (docs/research/step20-calibration-manifest.json), alpha 0 and 0.002 only

HOLDOUT.source: STEP 20 B-6 holdout trajectories (docs/research/step20-b6-holdout-manifest.json); frozen; never used for selection

dataScope.observations: STEP 15 NOAA GDP hourly QC (observationSha256 22c0ecff…), exact UTC matching, no interpolation

questions.Q1: does model error increase with time?
questions.Q3: does the alpha=0.002 vs alpha=0 difference grow systematically with time?
questions.Q4: is error concentrated in particular regions/units?
questions.Q6: systematic difference between model and observed displacement magnitude?
questions.Q7: systematic difference between model path length and observed displacement/path?
questions.Q8: does a single drifter dominate the error distribution? (no removal)
questions.Q9: does the windage term help only in particular units or increase error in particular units?
questions.Q10: scalar magnitude error vs directional/spatial displacement error?

metrics.A_positionError: haversine(observed, model) at each horizon, km
metrics.D_modelPathLength: sum of haversine over 900 s samples (and over hourly subsamples for fair comparison with observations)

F_directional.bearing: initial great-circle bearing release→endpoint, deg clockwise from north
F_directional.eastNorthOffset: model endpoint minus observed endpoint, km, equirectangular at observed latitude

speedPath.pathRatioHourly: model hourly path / observed hourly path (sampling note recorded)

alphaEffect.delta: E(alpha 0.002) − E(alpha 0) per horizon, consistency with STEP 20 tables within 0.001 km
alphaEffect.windageTowardObservation: projection of (P_0.002 − P_0) onto (P_obs − P_0) / |P_obs − P_0|^2; positive = toward observation

figures: F1 observed vs model endpoint error 24/48/72h
figureRules: axes from 0 over the full data range, no truncation; each figure states dataset, n, horizon, alpha, metric; deterministic SVG without external libraries

adequacyCategories.rule: one or more may apply; INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE when indicators do not separate; no threshold

reproducibility: independent re-run to a separate directory; table, summary and figures byte-identical
stopRule: STOP after STEP 21; STEP 22 not started; STEP 17–20 not modified; alpha not reselected
